notes.title: DEMO launches at Steam Next Fest October 2024 + update on the new mechanics
notes.content:
[h2]Hello, Commanders![/h2]
As it turns out, the Pacific is not the easiest ocean to cross. [b]However, we are slowly pushing forward[/b]. Now we’re back with an update for you.

The game is still in production. We are constantly working on expanding the available content to deliver the best possible product to you.

[b]In the meantime, we've added a number of new mechanics and improved the existing ones.[/b]

[h2]What can you expect?[/h2]
[b]In some missions, you will have access to tanks[/b] - a very powerful unit, though it has its limitations. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42400301/fdea5404f692df05685a9595b45391257482af57.png[/img]

From time to time, the command will be able to [b]delegate a destroyer to assist you[/b], providing artillery support. However, keep in mind that if misused, it can cause significant damage not only to the enemy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42400301/86b14d2ed05b6544b815ba530e4ae9d4928c28c3.png[/img]

[h2]These are just some of the new features that will be waiting for you...[/h2]

[b]The battles will take place on various Pacific islands[/b]. Among the many missions based on historical events, there will also be room for fictional scenarios, allowing you to experience alternate versions of history.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42400301/0ac1ff0893c199470727dc2964beb237a46a761f.png[/img]

We have also prepared[b] an additional tutorial mission[/b] to help you easily grasp all the basic game mechanics. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42400301/a75fdabdaa7ccb128d88419580c40c31e275d587.png[/img]

We also want to inform you that [b]we are showcasing a demo of our game at the Steam Next Fest[/b], which will take place this October. We want to give you a sample of our production to see if we’re heading in the right direction. Your feedback will help us plan our next steps.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1621910/Radio_Commander_Pacific_Campaign
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42400301/45f8ef2dd88e7600d524f56cc86dc4c8ce2d1c80.gif[/img]

[b]We are staying on course, so keep an eye out for further announcements.[/b]
Radio Commander: Pacific Campaign team

notes.title: Happy Independence Day!
notes.content:
[h2]Ahoy Commanders![/h2]

On this very occasion, we would like to share some hot news from the world of Radio Commander! Have you ever wondered how large-scale battles will be conducted? You don't have to anymore! We introduce you to tools such as a mission board, tactical map, and vertical plotting board:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42400301/6aa4ed4ab6d2f7dd1b12c9fd26d90183c6f00a15.gif[/img]

[h2]Mission Board[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42400301/5e475d4facfaa11f56dbd91317bc6169e23740b7.png[/img]
A Mission Board gives you an overview of the current state of air squadrons. You can see the mission that the squadron has to perform, and the time to start and finish it. You can see at what stage the mission is and when it will end.

[h2]Tactical Map[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42400301/5b38558e3141cb3c0618f6235a1ef88dcc6b8d20.png[/img]
A tactical map is a key tool for knowing the current tactical situation. To have proper knowledge of the battlefield, draw elements as reports arrive. You can add here enemy units and their type. Set the front lines, objectives, enemy locations, and tasks for your units, and remember to erase the outdated ones!

[h2]Vertical Plotting Board[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42400301/af2b3b977adc6b8bb31257f3ad57d08986d83a26.png[/img]
Vertical Plotting Board gives information about the situation in the air near the Task Force. The plotting officer draws the position of his own and enemy planes. Thanks to this, you will direct the fighters to the target when the enemy is heading towards your ships.

We hope you are excited about all that news! Happy Fourth of July and fair winds, Commanders!

[b]Squadron Studio Team[/b]
